description: This file contains implementations of binary search functions for object IDs and hashes, including 'oid_pos' and 'bsearch_hash', used for lookup operations within a Git-like repository system.

methods.name: take2
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit value from an object ID hash at a specified offset.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of an object ID within a sorted table, or the insertion point if not found.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search on a hash table to locate a specific hash value.
